description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the 'ModuleConfigDTD' functionality of the OpenMRS platform, specifically testing XML configuration validation using JUnit 5 parameterized tests. It tests XML validity with different module versions and presence/absence of certain XML elements.

classes.name: ModuleConfigDTDTest_V1_5
classes.description: A JUnit 5 test class for validating XML configuration files against a DTD in different scenarios, focusing on module version compatibility and presence of modules in OpenMRS.

methods.name: validXmlWithMultipleAwareOfModules
methods.description: Tests that a generated XML with multiple modules is valid according to the config XML validator.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts a DOM Document into its String XML representation.

methods.name: validXmlWithMissingVersion
methods.description: Tests that XML missing a version element is still considered valid.

methods.name: xmlFailsWithNoModules
methods.description: Tests that XML with no modules defined fails validation.

methods.name: getCompatibleVersions
methods.description: Provides a stream of version arguments for parameterized tests based on predefined compatible versions.
